item.title: Burnham announces plan for 10,000 work experience placements for young people – UK politics live
item.summary: Prime minister spoke to press while on visit to a Sainsbury’s supermarket this morning PA followed the prime minister around as he spoke to 14 to 16-year-olds on a summer careers programme and shoppers at Sainsbury’s in Nine Elms, south-west London. One man at the self-checkouts told him he hailed from Manchester and “London isn’t for me”. Andy Burnham replied: “I’m adapting.” Continue reading...
